SBS22a detection vs mutation burden
```{r}
## Getting blood and urine TMB distributoin
df <- data.table::fread("/mnt/data1/peter/repo/AAmanu/data/matGen/ds_filtered/output/SBS/UC_AA.SBS96.all") %>% as.data.frame()
df_count <- as.data.frame(colSums(df[,-1])) %>% 'colnames<-' ("mutLoad") %>% rownames_to_column(var = "Samples")

df_count %>% dplyr::filter(grepl(pattern = "Blood", x = Samples)) %>% pull(mutLoad) %>% median()
df_count %>% dplyr::filter(grepl(pattern = "Blood", x = Samples)) %>% pull(mutLoad) %>% quantile()
df_count %>% dplyr::filter(grepl(pattern = "Blood", x = Samples)) %>% pull(mutLoad) %>% min()
df_count %>% dplyr::filter(grepl(pattern = "Blood", x = Samples)) %>% pull(mutLoad) %>% max()

df_count %>% dplyr::filter(grepl(pattern = "Urine", x = Samples)) %>% pull(mutLoad) %>% median()
df_count %>% dplyr::filter(grepl(pattern = "Urine", x = Samples)) %>% pull(mutLoad) %>% quantile()
df_count %>% dplyr::filter(grepl(pattern = "Urine", x = Samples)) %>% pull(mutLoad) %>% min()
df_count %>% dplyr::filter(grepl(pattern = "Urine", x = Samples)) %>% pull(mutLoad) %>% max()
```

## Blood and Urine
```{r}
## Load mSigAct attribution result for blood and urine samples
## prior.sigs <- c("SBS1", "SBS5", "SBS22a", "SBS31", "SBS39", "SBS40a", "SBS100") 
load("/mnt/data1/peter/repo/AAmanu/data/mSigAct/dsnogermline_uc_cosmic_updatedarnoud.rda")

## Process data for plotting
ds_res <- sparseAssign$proposed.assignment %>% t() %>% as.data.frame() %>%
  sweep(1, rowSums(.), "/") %>% 
  rownames_to_column(var = "Samples") %>%
  gather(data = ., key = "signatures", value = "DS", -Samples) %>%
  dplyr::filter(signatures == "SBS22a")

boxplot_pd <- ds_res %>% mutate(type = case_when(grepl(pattern = "N", x = Samples) ~ "Normal",
                                                 grepl(pattern = "T", x = Samples) ~ "Tumor",
                                                 grepl(pattern = "_Blood", x = Samples) ~ "Blood",
                                                 grepl(pattern = "_Urine", x = Samples) ~ "Urine",
                                                 grepl(pattern = "_Kidney", x = Samples) ~ "Normal")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(grepl(pattern = "Blood|Urine", x = Samples)) %>%
  mutate(group = gsub(pattern = "_Blood|_Urine", replacement = "", x = Samples))

## Factor order
boxplot_pd$type <- factor(x = boxplot_pd$type, levels = c("Blood", "Urine"))

## Color annotation
color_anno <- c("#1B9E77", "black", "#D7191C", "#FDAE61")
names(color_anno) <- c("Normal", "Tumor", "Blood", "Urine")

## Wilcox test
wp <- wilcox.test(DS ~ type, data = boxplot_pd)$p.value

p10 <- ggplot(data = boxplot_pd, aes(x = type, y = DS, fill = type)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_point(size = 1, color = "black") +
  geom_line(aes(group = group), color = "black", linewidth = 0.15, alpha = 0.25) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, NA)) +
  ylab("SBS22a Attribution") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = color_anno) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 8),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 6),
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "none") +
  annotate("text", 
           x = 1.9, y = max(boxplot_pd$DS) * 1.05,
           label = paste0("p = ", signif(wp, 3)),
           size = 1.8)
p10
```

Coverage simulation
```{r}
## Load mSigAct results to retrieve the number of samples by type that are positive and negative for SBS22a
load("/mnt/data1/peter/repo/AAmanu/data/mSigAct/dsnogermline_uc_cosmic_updatedarnoud.rda")
ds_res <- sparseAssign$proposed.assignment %>% t() %>% as.data.frame() %>%
  sweep(1, rowSums(.), "/") %>% 
  rownames_to_column(var = "Samples") %>%
  gather(data = ., key = "signatures", value = "DS", -Samples) %>%
  dplyr::filter(signatures == "SBS22a") %>%
  mutate(type = case_when(grepl(pattern = "T", x = Samples) ~ "Tumor",
                          grepl(pattern = "N", x = Samples) ~ "Normal",
                          grepl(pattern = "Blood", x = Samples) ~ "Blood",
                          grepl(pattern = "Urine", x = Samples) ~ "Urine"))

## Number of samples that are positive and negative for SBS22a
tot_n <- as.data.frame(table(ds_res$type, ds_res$DS > 0.05)) %>%
  mutate(Var2 = ifelse(Var2 == TRUE, 1, 0))

## Resampled each sample 10 times at every coverage and ran mSigAct
# See code. /mnt/data1/peter/repo/AAmanu/code/coverage_simulation_30_15k.Rmd

## Load mSigAct signature attribution result
load("/mnt/data1/peter/repo/AAmanu/data/mSigAct/resamp_depth_30_15k_ds_uc_cosmic.rda")
resamp_depth_res <- sparseAssign$proposed.assignment %>% t() %>% as.data.frame() %>%
  sweep(1, rowSums(.), "/") %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ ifelse(.x < 0.05, 0, .x))) %>%
  sweep(1, rowSums(.), "/") %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "Samples") %>%
  mutate(replicate = sub("_[^_]+$", "", Samples),
         group = sub("_[^_]+$", "", replicate),
         replicate = sub(".*_", "", replicate),
         coverage = sub(".*_", "", Samples))

## Summarizing the resamping depth experiment. not all samples were a perfect 10 runs. Some dropped out due to low mutation count
number_rep_per_samp <- resamp_depth_res %>% count(group, coverage) %>%
  left_join(x = ., y = ds_res[, c("Samples", "DS", "type")], by = c("group"="Samples")) %>% 
  mutate(hr_status = ifelse(DS > 0.05, 1, 0)) ## This is SBS22a status from the original mSigAct result

# average at each iteration
resamp.mean <- resamp_depth_res %>%
  dplyr::group_by(group, coverage) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(value = mean(SBS22a), .groups = "drop_last")

## Factor order
resamp_depth_res$coverage <- factor(x = resamp_depth_res$coverage,
                                    levels = as.character(c(30, 60, 80, 100, 200, 500, 1000, 2000, 4000, 8000, 10000, 12500, 15000))) 

resamp_depth_res$group <- factor(x = resamp_depth_res$group,
                                   levels = c("UC2T", "UC2N", "UC4T", "UC4N", "UC5T", "UC5N", "UC7T", "UC7N", "UC7_Blood",
                                              "UC10T", "UC10N", "UC11T", "UC11N", "UC13T", "UC13N", "UC14T", "UC14N", "UC14_Blood",
                                              "UC14_Urine", "UC18T", "UC18N", "UC18_Blood", "UC18_Urine", "UC19T", "UC19N", "UC19_Blood",
                                              "UC19_Urine", "UC26T", "UC26N", "UC34T", "UC34N", "UC34_Blood"))

## Process data for plotting
pd <- resamp_depth_res %>%
  left_join(x = ., y = ds_res[,c("Samples", "DS")], by = c("group"="Samples")) %>%
  mutate(status = DS,
         type = case_when(grepl(pattern = "_Blood", x = Samples) ~ "Blood",
                          grepl(pattern = "_Urine", x = Samples) ~ "Urine",
                          grepl(pattern = "_Kidney", x = Samples) ~ "Normal",
                          grepl(pattern = "T", x = Samples) ~ "Tumor",
                          grepl(pattern = "N", x = Samples) ~ "Normal"),
         hr_status = ifelse(status > 0.05, "Detected", "Undetected"))

## Get mean/sd/ci
typeerror.pd <- pd %>%
  group_by(coverage, type, hr_status) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(SBS22a, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(SBS22a, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = sum(!is.na(SBS22a)),
    se = sd / sqrt(n),
    ci = qt(0.975, df = n - 1) * se
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    lwr = mean - ci,
    upr = mean + ci
  )

## Factor order
typeerror.pd$type <- factor(x = typeerror.pd$type, levels = c("Tumor", "Normal","Blood", "Urine"))
status.col <- c("grey50", "firebrick3", "black")
names(status.col) <- c("Undetected", "Detected", "Proportion Detected")

## Getting the total number of samples per type and coverage for proportion calculation
nsamp_per_coverage_per_hr_status_per_tissue_type <- number_rep_per_samp %>%
  dplyr::group_by(type, coverage, hr_status) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(tot_n = sum(n))

## Calculating how many samples were detected with mSigAct
hits <- pd %>% mutate(hr_status = ifelse(hr_status == "Detected", 1, 0)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(type, coverage, hr_status) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n_sbs22a = sum(SBS22a > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(x = ., y = nsamp_per_coverage_per_hr_status_per_tissue_type, 
            by = c("type", "coverage", "hr_status")) %>%
  mutate(prop = n_sbs22a / tot_n,
         hr_status = ifelse(hr_status == 1, "Detected", "Undetected"))

## Factor order again
typeerror.pd <- typeerror.pd %>% left_join(x = ., y = hits, by = c("coverage", "type", "hr_status"))
typeerror.pd[is.na(typeerror.pd)] <- 0

typeerror.pd$coverage <- factor(x = typeerror.pd$coverage,
                                    levels = as.character(c(30, 60, 80, 100, 200, 500, 1000, 2000, 4000, 8000, 10000, 12500, 15000)))

typeerror.pd <- typeerror.pd %>% dplyr::filter(hr_status == "Detected")
typeerror.pd$type <- factor(x = typeerror.pd$type, levels = c("Tumor", "Normal", "Blood", "Urine"))

## Color annotation
color_anno <- c("#A6A6A6", "#4F81BD", "#D7191C", "#FDAE61")
names(color_anno) <- c("Normal", "Tumor", "Blood", "Urine")

p11 <- ggplot(data = typeerror.pd, aes(x = coverage, y = prop, color = type, group = type)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.9, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.25, color = "black") +
  annotate("text",
           x = 4.25,
           y = 0.93,
           label = "90% recovered",
           hjust = 1,
           size = 1.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = color_anno) +
  ylab("Fraction Recovered") + xlab("Simulated Duplex Depth") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 6),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 8),
        strip.background = element_blank(), 
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 6, margin = margin(b = 0, t = 0)),
        panel.spacing = unit(0.1, "lines"),
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        legend.key.size = unit(0.2, "cm"),
        legend.position = c(0.95, 0.98),
        legend.direction = "horizontal",
        legend.justification = c(1, 0),
        legend.background = element_blank(),
        legend.key = element_blank(),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 5))
```

Checking correlation between sbs22a attribution between tissue (tumor/normal) and non-invasive (blood/urine)
```{r}
load("/mnt/data1/peter/repo/AAmanu/data/mSigAct/dsnogermline_uc_cosmic_updatedarnoud.rda")

ds_res <- sparseAssign$proposed.assignment %>% t() %>% as.data.frame() %>%
  sweep(1, rowSums(.), "/") %>% 
  rownames_to_column(var = "Samples") %>%
  gather(data = ., key = "signatures", value = "DS", -Samples) %>%
  dplyr::filter(signatures == "SBS22a") %>%
  mutate(type = case_when(grepl(pattern = "T", x = Samples) ~ "Tumor",
                          grepl(pattern = "N", x = Samples) ~ "Normal",
                          grepl(pattern = "Blood", x = Samples) ~ "Blood",
                          grepl(pattern = "Urine", x = Samples) ~ "Urine"),
         group = paste0("UC", as.numeric(str_extract(Samples, "\\d+"))))

blood_samp <- ds_res$Samples[grepl(pattern = "Blood", x = ds_res$Samples)] %>% 
  gsub(pattern = "\\_.*", replacement = "", x = .)

df1 <- ds_res %>% dplyr::filter(group %in% blood_samp) %>%
  dplyr::select(-Samples, -signatures) %>%
  spread(data = ., key = type, value = DS)

## Correlation with tumor and blood?
cor.test(df1$Tumor,
         df1$Blood,
         method = "spearman")
## Correlation with normal and blood?
cor.test(df1$Normal,
         df1$Blood,
         method = "spearman")

## Now do it for urine
df2 <- df1 %>% dplyr::filter(!if_any(everything(), is.na))
## Tumor and urine?
cor.test(df2$Tumor,
         df2$Urine,
         method = "spearman")
## Normal and urine?
cor.test(df2$Normal,
         df2$Urine,
         method = "spearman")

```
